review: The synthetic private-research display entry supplies supporting retrievalStatus and null topicId, authorityRank and supersededBy, matching ordinary non-primary manifest defaults. It remains canonical:false and separate from DOC_MANIFEST; these fields are local display metadata and create no retrieval grant.

The badge renderer removes comparison with all because normalizeDocTaxonomyFilter only returns the four named categories or uncategorized. The category mapping and generated scientific metadata are unchanged.

Existing taxonomy/private-research/translation and math-copy UI suites are canonical/public-preview byte-parity inputs. They are used unchanged for validation, not added to the selected-source index. These tests exercise rendering and interaction, not physical calculation or certificate integrity.
limits: Unfrozen, unpublished and uninstalled. No actual private document is loaded, exported or added to the public manifest.
Export validation loads the selected DocViewerPanel and uses canonical dependencies. Generated metadata remains held at older preview bytes; this does not establish full preview application parity.
